info.title: tada
info.description: The tada HTTP API. The list of problem codes of each operation is open.

get.summary: Lists the events that the caller can see, in the order of their keys.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary: Creates an event in the caller's organization.
post.description:
If an event with the same `id` and the same content exists, the response is this event with the
status 200, and nothing changes.

200.description: The event exists with this ID and the same content.

get.summary: Reads one event. The caller needs an event role in it, or the organization role owner or admin.

post.summary: Creates a link code for the calling member.

get.summary: Lists the open link requests of the calling member.

post.summary: Confirms a link request. Only then does tada bind the Telegram account to the member.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The ID of the link request.

post.summary:
Asks for a magic link. The answer is the same for each address (ADR 0008).
Only a member gets a mail. Too many requests for one address or from one client get
`rate-limited` with `Retry-After` (ADR 0056).

202.description: The request is accepted. The body is empty.

post.summary:
Signs in with the token of a magic link. The token works once.
The response sets the session cookie.

200.description: The new session. The `Set-Cookie` header holds its token.

get.summary: Reads the session of the request. A session without an organization also gets its information.

post.summary: Chooses or changes the organization of the session (ADR 0056). The token stays the same.
Signs out: ends the session and clears the cookie. It also succeeds without a session.
Shows the organization and the role of an invitation. It does not use the token.

Accepts an invitation. The token works once. The response sets the cookie of a new session
in the organization of the invitation.

200.description: The new session. The `Set-Cookie` header holds its token.

get.summary: Lists the event memberships of an event. Only its event managers see them.

200.description: All event memberships of the event.

post.summary: Gives a member of the organization an event role. Only event managers can do this.

Changes the event role of a member. Only event managers can do this.
The only event manager of an event keeps the role: the change gives `invalid-transition`.

Removes the event role of a member. The member loses access to the event with the next request.
The only event manager of an event cannot be removed: this gives `invalid-transition`.

get.summary:
Lists the members of the organization, in the order of their display names.
Each member can read the list. Only owners and admins get the email addresses.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary: Removes a member from the organization, with all event memberships of the member.
post.description:
Owners and admins remove members; only an owner removes an owner. Each member can leave.
The last owner and the only event manager of an event stay: this gives `invalid-transition`.
The member loses access with the next request.

get.summary: Lists the pending invitations, the oldest first. Only owners and admins see them.

post.summary: Invites a person into the organization. The worker sends the invitation mail.
post.description:
A pending invitation of the same email address is revoked. If an invitation with the same `id`
and the same content exists, the response is this invitation with the status 200.

200.description: The invitation exists with this ID and the same content.

post.summary:
Revokes a pending invitation. Its links stop working at once.
Only owners and admins can do this.

get.summary: Lists the documents of the event, the newest first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only the documents whose name contains this text, without regard to case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary: Uploads a file as the first version of a new document in the event.
post.description:
The body is the raw file with the media type `application/octet-stream`, not a multipart form,
so that the server streams it to the object storage. The header `X-File-Name` holds the file
name, percent-encoded as UTF-8. The server detects the type from the content (ADR 0055).
The body can be as large as `TADA_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES`. The caller needs the event role
contributor or manager, or the organization role owner or admin (ADR 0052).

parameters.name: X-File-Name
parameters.description: The file name, percent-encoded as UTF-8.

requestBody.description: The raw file. Not a multipart form.

default.description: A problem (ADR 0037). An upload over the storage quota is `validation-failed` with the entry `quota-exceeded` on `/file`.

get.summary: Reads one document with its newest version.
Lists the versions of the document, in the order of their numbers.

post.summary: Uploads a file as a new version of the document. The older versions stay unchanged.
post.description: The body has the same form as for `upload_document`.

parameters.name: X-File-Name
parameters.description: The file name, percent-encoded as UTF-8.

requestBody.description: The raw file. Not a multipart form.

201.description: The document with the new version as its newest version.

default.description: A problem (ADR 0037). An upload over the storage quota is `validation-failed` with the entry `quota-exceeded` on `/file`.

get.summary: Downloads the file of a document version.
get.description:
The response has the media type that tada detected, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, a
`Content-Security-Policy` that allows nothing, and the file name in `Content-Disposition`
(RFC 6266). `disposition=inline` applies only to PDF and plain text (ADR 0009, ADR 0043).

parameters.name: version_id
parameters.description: The ID of the document version.

schema.description: How the browser handles a download.

200.description: The file. Its media type is the `media_type` of the version.

get.summary: Reads the event profile. Each member who can read the event can read it.

Lists the field catalog of an event: the shipped fields and the fields of the event, in the order of their keys.
Each field has the JSON Schema of its values.

200.description: The field catalog of the event.

get.summary: Lists the changesets of an event with open proposals, oldest first. Only its event managers see them.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only `open` exists: the changesets with at least one open proposal.

schema.description: The filter of a list of changesets.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

post.summary:
Creates a changeset of proposals in an event, with the channel `web`.
Contributors and event managers can propose; a viewer gets `forbidden`.
post.description:
If a changeset with the same `id` and the same content exists, the response is this changeset with the
status 200, and nothing changes.

200.description: The changeset exists with this ID and the same content.

get.summary:
The Review Inbox: the changesets with open proposals that the caller can review, oldest first.
They are the changesets of each event that the caller manages and, for owners and admins,
the changesets of the organization, for example one that creates an event.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only `open` exists: the changesets with at least one open proposal.

schema.description: The filter of a list of changesets.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size: 1 to 200. The default is 50.

get.summary:
Reads a changeset with each proposal, its evidence, its status and the current value of its target.
Only the reviewers of the changeset can read it.

post.summary:
Accepts the selected proposals and their dependencies, all or nothing (ADR 0050).
A changed target gives `record-version-conflict`, and the proposals concerned get the status `conflict`.
A selected proposal that is not open gives `invalid-transition`.

Rejects open proposals and the open proposals that depend on them.
A proposal that is not open gives `invalid-transition`.

user_id.description: A member of the caller's organization.

state.description: The state and value that the reviewer accepts instead of the proposed one.

value.description:
A fact value. Its type must match the value type of the field.
The read tools give values in the same shape (ADR 0040).

oneOf.description:
A decimal number or range in the unit of the field, as text, for example `"20000"` or `"1.5"`.

An amount or range in the minor unit of the currency of the field, for example 1500 for CHF 15.00.
A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
A range of dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, with the meaning of its dates.

The input of `CreateChangeset`: the text of one intake and the proposals that it supports.

markdown.description:
CommonMark with tables, UTF-8, one sentence per line. No raw HTML and no images.
A fact is an empty link to an exact fact version: `[](tada:fact/<fact-uuid>?v=<n>)`.
A source passage is a link with the supporting words: `[words](tada:source/<source-version-uuid>#<start>-<end>)`.
Each link must cite an accepted fact version, an assumption or an unknown of the event, never an open proposal,
or a source version that the member can see.

reason.description: A short reason for the proposal.

source_text.description:
The member's own words. tada stores them as a source version.
The passages count characters (Unicode scalar values) of this text after normalization: Unicode NFC with `\n` line ends.

facts.description:
The current version of each fact of the event, in the order of the field keys.
A field without a fact is absent. An unknown fact is present with the state `unknown`.

proposals.description: The fact proposals of the event without a review result, oldest first. They are not accepted state.

open_questions.description: The open questions of the event, in the order of their numbers.

EventRole.description: The role of a member in one event.

Fact.description: The current version of one fact.

field_key.description: The key of the field, for example `date_window`.

value.description: The value. It is absent if the state is `unknown`.

organization_name.description: The name of the organization of the invitation.

role.description: The role that the invitation gives.

token.description: The token from the fragment of the invitation link.

id.description: The UUIDv7 of the new invitation. A client that sends it can retry the request safely.

role.description: An owner invites with any role; an admin with admin or member.

oneOf.description: The ID of a Fluent message of the web client, for example `field-date_window`.

email.description: The email address. Only owners and admins get it.

version.description: The record version of the organization membership. `RemoveMember` needs it.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page. It is absent on the last page.

open_proposals.description: The number of its open proposals.

page.description: The page of a PDF, from 1.

errors.description: The invalid values of a `validation-failed` problem.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the value in the request body, for example `/key`.

code.description: The reason, for example `taken`. The list of codes is open.

memberships.description: All memberships of the user, in the order of the organization names.

email.description: The email address of the member.

TelegramLinkCode.description: A new link code. The member sends it to the bot within ten minutes.

code.description: The code. It works once. The server shows it only in this response.
